body:
Make sure messages are not deleted by default.
Other side may delete messages, for example in telegram, but our system should keep them all and mark deleted by default, but it should be still possible to recover messages, and deletion should happen only if the user of meta-sovereign will agree to it also, and will select to actually deleted messages that were marked as deleted.

That also will allow to support backups from systems like VK, that don't actually delete messages, from full account data backups, bug just mark them as deleted.

We need to ensure all providers have the same behavior, so our unified links data store is always friendly for backups. Yet by default it should be encrypted with user pin/password (user should be able to change ways to access the system, we should also support passkeys, authenticator apps and so, so all different ways to decrypt the master key, which in turn will be used to decrypt all the data by the system, to provide additional guard to leaking any personal data of other people and own data of the user. The system should have decrypted data only in memory, so everything that is saved on disk (should be fully encrypted at all times).

And if user looses keys, he will be forced to provide access tokens / passwords / keys and so to all the services again, but as these service may no longer store deleted messages (that were deleted more than 6 months ago) loosing access to the system may mean loosing some of the data.

Yet exported data is encrypted, and user should be warned, that he is responsible for securing exported data. We should also provide a way to extract data as encrypted archives to help user make backups that are also encrypted.

Make sure our requirements file is updated to reflect all these requirements.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in a single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Improvements and hardening system from data loss or unauthorized access
